subject: Can't download RSTAN source tarball (403 FORBIDDEN)

messages.author: ebac19664dad3407
messages.subject: Can't download RSTAN source tarball (403 FORBIDDEN)
parts:
There seems to be a permissions problem at the rstan googlecode repository.

When I try to install rstan with

options(repos = c(getOption("repos"), rstan = "http://wiki.rstan-repo.googlecode.com/git/"))
install.packages('rstan', lib=.libPaths()[2], type = 'source')



I get an error message

Error in download.file(url, destfile, method, mode = "wb", ...) : cannot open URL 'http://wiki.rstan-repo.googlecode.com/git/src/contrib/rstan_2.2.0.tar.gz'


If I navigate manually to the URL http://wiki.rstan-repo.googlecode.com/git/src/contrib/ in my browser, I can see the directory listing,

Revision 318c931b4715: /src/contrib

[Project Page]

  • ..
  • PACKAGES
  • PACKAGES.gz
  • rstan_2.0.1.tar.gz
  • rstan_2.1.0.tar.gz
  • rstan_2.1.1.tar.gz
  • rstan_2.2.0.tar.gz

If I click on PACKAGES or PACKAGES.gz, I can download them, but if I click on any of rstan_*.tar.gz, I get a 403 error.

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Can't download RSTAN source tarball (403 FORBIDDEN)
parts:
I was able to use git to clone the repository to my local disk and then install from the local file:

git clone http://code.google.com/p/rstan-repo.wiki/  ~/rstan.git

And then from inside R:

install.packages(path.expand('~/rstan.git/src/contrib/rstan_2.2.0.tar.gz'), repos=NULL, type='source')
